purpose: Freeze conservative account-scoped Ross Cameron behavior evidence for the ten dates registered and replayed before any source in this batch was opened.

source_batch.copyright_handling: Only source metadata, hashes, explicit corrections, and short paraphrased evidence summaries are retained in the repository.

label_policy.evidence_timing_limit: These recaps usually establish sequence and account action, not an exact decision timestamp.
